specs.title: ETM-8868 - Condition colour stays visible on a highlighted row

annotations.description: step 4 needs a person: Red cell is clearly red (255,204,199) among yellow cells, so still recognised as red. But it is not shown WITH the highlight colour: it is plain red, no mix with FFFB8F (earlier build: orange mix). Person decides if this meets "shown with the highlight colour". Looked at the picture. | step 6 needs a person: Red cell rgb(255,204,199) is the same colour as the highlighted row (255,204,199): red cell cannot be told apart from the rest of the row (picture step-6). Red is "visible" only as it equals the highlight; likely fails the intent. Person decides. | step 14 needs a person: No clear on-screen way to make a dependency conflict is given in the Test (no Dev steps); not attempted, as the Test says. | step 15 needs a person: Depends on step 14: no red border was made, so border + FFFB8F cannot be checked. Reloaded without Save: 0 error cells, no highlight, Save disabled.

steps.title: 1. In the Manpower Resource histogram right-click the resource of the task and choose `Delete Resource` (do not Save)
2. Record how the red cell looks with no highlight
3. Right-click the row with the red cell, open `Highlight Row` and choose `FFFB8F`
4. Look at the red cell
steps.why: Red cell is clearly red (255,204,199) among yellow cells, so still recognised as red. But it is not shown WITH the highlight colour: it is plain red, no mix with FFFB8F (earlier build: orange mix). Person decides if this meets "shown with the highlight colour". Looked at the picture.

steps.title: 5. Right-click the same row, open `Highlight Row` and choose `FFCCC6`
6. Look at the red cell
steps.why: Red cell rgb(255,204,199) is the same colour as the highlighted row (255,204,199): red cell cannot be told apart from the rest of the row (picture step-6). Red is "visible" only as it equals the highlight; likely fails the intent. Person decides.

steps.title: 7. Right-click the row, open `Highlight Row` and choose `No Color`
9. Right-click the row of that task, open `Highlight Row` and choose `FFFB8F`
10. In the Manpower Resource histogram right-click the resource and choose `Delete Resource` (do not Save)
12. Right-click the row, open `Highlight Row` and choose `No Color`
13. Right-click the row again, open `Highlight Row` and choose `FFFB8F`
14. Make a dependency conflict on the row (no Dev steps yet: if there is no clear way on screen, stop here and mark `needs-human`)
steps.why: No clear on-screen way to make a dependency conflict is given in the Test (no Dev steps); not attempted, as the Test says.

steps.title: 15. Look at the row, then reload without Save
steps.why: Depends on step 14: no red border was made, so border + FFFB8F cannot be checked. Reloaded without Save: 0 error cells, no highlight, Save disabled.
